meta.source_system: Kubernetes official docs Pod Lifecycle (PodPhase), transcribed by field-trial W2 from pinned public docs
source_citation: Kubernetes 官方文档 Pod Lifecycle 页: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/
- W1 快照 dossier/sources/k8s_pod_lifecycle.html；W2 本会话（2026-10-31）WebFetch 在线抽查：5 相定义、lifecycle 句、
node-death 句、1.27 deletion 句、PodGC 句与快照逐句一致
- 关键原文（全部在 transcription_notes.cell_citations 逐边回引）: lifecycle 句 / Pending,Running,Succeeded,Failed,Unknown 相定义 /
"If a node dies or is disconnected..." / "Since Kubernetes 1.27, the kubelet transitions deleted Pods to a terminal phase..." /
"Along with cleaning up the Pods, PodGC will also mark them as failed if they are in a non-terminal phase."
辅助主张来源（W1 快照，未进转录）: kubernetes.io Deployment 页、Service 页
meta.encoding: 5 个真实 PodPhase + 3 个填充哑态 filler_5/6/7（8=2^3）；填充态边不引用真实事件语义
meta.semantics_class: event: 7 个动作是控制面/节点侧外部事件（调度启动、容器终止、节点失联、删除、GC），名字独立于状态 -> groups 必须声明 semantics {"action": "fixed"}
meta.transcription_rules: K1 散文文档转录：每条边回引文档原句（cell_citations），无语句支撑的格记 -1.0 并入 not_collected；K2 pod_deletion 的 Succeeded/Failed 条件分支→等概率占位（1.27 句为条件式）；K3 Unknown 两格（Pending/Running→Unknown）为定义式弱依据，cell_citations 中标注 weak；K4 Succeeded/Failed 按文档 terminal 语义作吸收态；K5 奖励约定见 reward_rule。
meta.reward_rule: +1.0 仅'进入 Succeeded'的结果分支（Running|all_containers_succeeded；Running|pod_deletion 的 Succeeded 分支）；-1.0 为文档未陈述迁移的 (相,事件)（含全部'未收录'格）；terminal 相吸收自环与填充态 0.0。奖励为转录约定非 K8s 语义（声明）。

cell_citations.Pending|container_start: 引文: "Pods follow a defined lifecycle, starting in the Pending phase, moving through Running if at least one of its primary containers starts OK, and then through either the Succeeded or Failed phases depending on whether any container in the Pod terminated in failure."（kubernetes.io pod-lifecycle 页（W1 快照 + W2 2026-10-31 WebFetch 在线抽查一致））；Running 相定义 "The Pod has been bound to a node, and all of the containers have been created."（同页）
cell_citations.Pending|all_containers_succeeded: Pending 相无'全部容器成功终止'语义（Pending 定义：容器尚未建好/未就绪）；文档未给出该迁移 → 未收录，模型记 -1.0 惩罚自环
cell_citations.Pending|any_container_failed: 文档未给出 Pending 直接因容器失败进入 Failed 的迁移语句（lifecycle 句把 Failed 挂在 Running 之后）→ 未收录，记 -1.0
cell_citations.Pending|node_lost: 引文: "If a node dies or is disconnected from the rest of the cluster, Kubernetes applies a policy for setting the phase of all Pods on the lost node to Failed."（kubernetes.io pod-lifecycle 页（W1 快照 + W2 2026-10-31 WebFetch 在线抽查一致））；node death policy 覆盖 lost node 上'所有 Pods'（含 Pending）
cell_citations.Pending|kubelet_unreachable: Unknown 相定义: "For some reason the state of the Pod could not be obtained. This phase typically occurs due to an error in communicating with the node where the Pod should be running."——定义式弱依据（判读标注：weak，定义暗示相可出现于节点失联，未写成迁移语句）
cell_citations.Pending|pod_deletion: deleted Pods 转 terminal 相的语句以容器退出状态为条件（Since Kubernetes 1.27, the kubelet transitions deleted Pods to a terminal phase (Failed or Succeeded depending on the exit statuses of the pod containers) before their deletion from the API server）；Pending 的容器未创建、退出状态无定义 → 未收录，记 -1.0
cell_citations.Pending|gc_mark_failed: 引文: "Along with cleaning up the Pods, PodGC will also mark them as failed if they are in a non-terminal phase."（kubernetes.io pod-lifecycle 页（W1 快照 + W2 2026-10-31 WebFetch 在线抽查一致））；non-terminal phase 含 Pending
cell_citations.Running|container_start: Running 相下'容器又启动一个'的迁移文档未陈述（Running 定义允许 starting/restarting 但未写相变）→ 未收录，记 -1.0

deleted-Pods 转 terminal 相以'容器退出状态'为条件；Pending 容器未创建，无定义
